2021 SPORTAGE
AN SUV TRULY BORN
TO EXPLORE.
OUTFITTED FOR THE
ROAD LESS TRAVELED.
TRAIL-TUNED PERFORMANCE.
Most days, you won’t have to crawl over rocks, take on steep inclines, power through sand,
or plow through snow. But it’s nice to know you can. And when the day does arrive, you’ll
have the confidence that comes with available capability features like torque-vectoring
all-wheel drive,3 multiple drive modes, and a 237-horsepower turbocharged engine.
LOOKS TO MATCH.
One glance at Sportage, and you know it’s an SUV that can do it all. The aggressive hood
lines, sweeping LED headlights, and eye-catching chrome accents radiate across the
aerodynamic and rugged profile. The rear features full-width tail lights, and the design
is completed by the unique wheels found on each trim.
A BEAUTY IN NIGHTFALL.
Blacked-out badging. Blacked-out grille. Blacked-out trim. It can only mean one thing: The
2021 Sportage Nightfall Edition. You can add this daring sense of style to the outstanding
capability and tech available on the S trim level.
